listings.name: 300 Athol St, Whitby
listings.fitNote: Textbook system fit: 8 units, brick & block, 50 years same owner, explicit rental upside, coin laundry income. Legacy rents almost certain — this is the repositioning profile the 3-4 year capital recovery model wants.

listings.name: 150 Celina St, Oshawa
listings.fitNote: Central Oshawa, entry price inside the band. Unit count and rent roll unpublished — request rent roll and 12-month actuals before underwriting.

listings.name: 271 Tresane St, Oshawa
listings.fitNote: New build already leased at market with scheduled increases — $450k/unit and no rent gap means no forced-appreciation lever. Fails the capital recovery gate despite being a clean asset.

listings.name: Simcoe Residence, 1645 Simcoe St N
listings.fitNote: Purpose-built student (2015) beside Ontario Tech / Durham College, 96.7% occupancy. Bigger than target band and student model carries immigration-policy exposure — but rental optimization upside is real. Price on request.

listings.name: Ontario East Portfolio
listings.fitNote: 152 units, 75% renovated, stabilized. Institutional scale and the value-add is mostly done. JV-syndication territory, not a personal capital-recovery play.

listings.name: 4-unit apartment, Hamilton Mountain
listings.fitNote: Listed ~$1.02M USD (~$1.43M CAD). Under 5 units means residential financing rules, not DCR-based commercial — verify rents vs Mountain market before pursuing.

listings.name: 9-unit mixed-use, downtown Hamilton
listings.fitNote: Strong unit mix with 9 parking spaces and ground-floor retail. Mixed-use complicates CMHC financing but the residential count fits the band. New boiler 2020.
